newsitem.title: UK: Novorossiisk Berth 1 may close briefly for work.
newsitem.headline: Novorossiisk Berth 1 may close briefly for work.

text.p: The largest crude berth at Russia's Black Sea Novorossiisk oil port may close for a few days in the last part of May for maintenance, a leading shipping source said on Tuesday.
The smaller Berth Two and Three, closed since May 6 for scheduled maintenance, will open on May 25, the source said.

Asked to comment on a trader's remarks that Berth One will close May 20-23, the source said: "It's quite possible, there have been shuttings due to maintenance for the last five months towards the end of the month.
"I haven't got official confirmation of it but it would fit in the pattern we have been seeing for the past four or five months."
The closure of Berth One would probably cause a two day delay in oil loadings, "but if it is scheduled and it is in the programme, I think people would have planned around it," the source added.
Berth One can load ships over 90,000 tonne deadweight while Berth Two, the second largest, can take ships from 60,000 to 90,000 tonnes deadweight. Berth Three is a small oil products berth.
